load_text_encoder_model: load a text encoder model from a local checkpoint path with configurable dtype and CPU offload
load_text_encoder_native: load a native transformers text encoder using AutoModel.from_pretrained with precision from pipeline config
prepare_text_encoder_weights: prepare text encoder weight files by scanning for safetensors or pt files and filtering duplicates
get_text_encoder_weights_iterator: get a generator of weight name-tensor pairs from text encoder checkpoint files with optional prefix
extract_text_encoder_index: extract the zero-based index from a text encoder component name like text_encoder_2
